Therefore,
the petitioners shall now appear before - 10 - NC: 2025:KHC-D:17241 HC-KAR the concerned SLAO on 15.12.2025 at 11.00 a.m. and on the appearance of the petitioners, the concerned SLAO shall act in accordance with the Government Order dated 09.10.2025 and disburse the award amount / the consent award amount.
7. With the aforesaid observations, petition stands disposed.
